sunday 18h oct. the collection amounted to € 1456 thank you for your generosity. we also have the donate button on the website for those of you who wish to contribute online and we now have a tap to donate machine in the church. eucharistic adoration in st. canice’s there will be eucharistic adoration in st. canice’s church on wed 28th oct from 2pm – 4pm. our special prayer intention is for vocations to the priesthood and religious life in our diocese. all welcome. novena in honour of saint martin de porres in the black abbey, 28th oct to thurs 5th nov. mass each day 10.30am & 7.30pm. mass & anointing of the sick on sunday 1st at 3.00pm. october and november envelopes the envelopes for the october and november offerings are available for collection at the parish office, by the distributors, thank you for your continued help with this. rosary will be recited in james green on thursday the 29th of october at 6-30pm. it is the pro- life intention. all are welcome

"a great cloud of witnesses": feast of all saints this november 1st on the feast of all saints, our parish is blessed to offer a unique encounter with the church universal. at our 11:30am mass , over 3,000 first-class relics of martyrs and saints will be displayed for public veneration. whether you have a devotion to a specific saint or simply wish to draw closer to the mysteries of heaven, we encourage you to join us for this prayerful occasion. let us gather together to venerate these holy relics and draw strength from the lives of the saints. fr. willie purcell -
